banner.title: external-secrets
banner.tagline: Syncs 1Password items into Kubernetes Secrets through the Connect server, and pushes Secrets back where a PushSecret asks.

art.about: secrets pulled from a vault through a connect server and pushed back
art.title: How external-secrets moves secrets

explainer.title: Pull from 1Password, push back through a separate store

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: onepassword-connect runs the Connect API and sync containers, reading the credentials file from key 1password-credentials.json in Secret onepassword-secret.

steps.title: Stores
steps.text: ClusterSecretStore onepassword reads vaults in priority order. onepassword-automation writes to the Automation vault only.

steps.title: Pull
steps.text: The controller turns each ExternalSecret into a Secret and refreshes it on the interval that ExternalSecret sets.
steps.scene: a document synced into a secret box

steps.title: Push
steps.text: A PushSecret copies a Secret's keys into a 1Password item through the write store, so pushes cannot resolve into Homelab.
steps.scene: a sealed document leaving a box toward a vault
